angle: MOONSHOT PLANNER, written 25 Sep ~13:20 UTC. Bottom line first. No bet in the candidate pool, the critic's list or the browser intel has more than ~0.01 probability of adding the +0.017 needed to go from x138's 0.953 to 0.97. 0.99 is ~0: it is above the LB top (0.975) and would need adjusted edge ~0.95 plus division J ~0.4 on unseen embryos. So this plan maximises the three things we control: (1) THE FINAL IS max(F1, F2) ON PRIVATE, so the second final is a free option. E[max] = F1 + E[(F2 - F1)+], so one final should be the runtime-proof file that beats x138, and the other should be the highest-variance candidate that passed an embryo-held-out gate and did not break on public. It should not automatically be a near-copy. A variance F2 is worth ~+0.0005..+0.001 expected, vs exp52's +0.00006..+0.0005 premium (v_ensembles-and-private_finals-private-emax-x138-era_value.json). exp52 wins only if the #34/#35 latencies show real runtime risk, because it is guard-free. That switch is pre-registered (DR3). (2) THE ONE 'MOONSHOT' WITH A BIG PAYOFF IS A SIGN, NOT A SIZE. 241 teams share x138's deterministic score. The block spans public ranks ~166-406, while silver is ~top 195 and bronze ~top 390 of 3,899 (browser_intel.md s.6.0C). If the order survives on private, beating x138 by epsilon puts us near the silver line, and a tie puts us at the block's end (~406, no medal). F1 therefore must differ from x138 verbatim through changes whose private sign is reliably >= 0: lowrefine (C05), runtime safety (C01 + N1 part A), and DaughterNet insertion only if #35 supports it. (3) SPEND SPARE GPU ONLY ON VARIANCE BETS THAT HAVE AN HONEST HELD-OUT TEST. There are ~45 unplanned GPU-h (vitalii 30 after the 26 Sep reset, sasyami 30 if friend A answers). Ranked: M1 = the DeepCenter safe-division threshold judged on 6bba. DeepCenter never saw 6bba (split_manifest: train = the 71 44b6 clips, browser 6.1 item 2), and it rejects ~80% of geometric division candidates on the dummies (84/121, 149/155, 8/13, 203/222), so this is the one division knob with a real held-out bed. M3 = the dense-label (dorado Ultrack) SECONDARY, which gives 80% of the detection logits. Only 44b6 and dorado data go in, and it is judged on held-out 6bba. It is the only bet using the top teams' mechanism (more labels -> better detection in dense regions): P(qualifies as F2) ~0.06, and it needs the user's go. M2 = axis-flip TTA on x138: cheap and runtime-neutral, but low variance, because its old local +0.02 is probably memorised views. In that test the 80%-weight secondary stayed in-sample (RESULTS.md l.52/106/90), and public scored -0.001 (exp37). C07 tempfuse is an optional 4th. Deliberately NOT done for 29 Sep: primary or detector retraining, head retrain, secondary blends or third detectors, knob ladders on public, the N2 metadata probe, and transductive test-crop consensus. C11 and the 10/10 refuting skeptic files, N2's verifier, and imissher's 8/8 negative public probes (743222) cover these. The friend-A-only out-of-embryo dense-label A/B (E13) is kept as research for the 'path to 0.97+' write-up. It never ships by 29 Sep.
outlook: All numbers are guesses with the reasoning stated. PUBLIC (the file we pick as F1): expected ~0.9535. #34 should print exactly 0.953 (exp56 reproduced every x138 per-clip count, browser s.6.0B). Insertion adds +0..+0.001 if #35 holds. lowrefine/forkmid/safetail are +0.000..+0.001 and mostly invisible at the 0.001 display step. P(public >= 0.955) ~0.20: it needs one of M1/M2/M3/C07 or a combo to show +0.002; each has P ~0.05-0.1. P(>= 0.96) ~0.02, P(>= 0.97) ~0.003, P(>= 0.99) < 0.001. PRIVATE (the max of our two finals). The ABSOLUTE level is dominated by something we cannot influence: how hard the private embryos are. The same stack family scores 0.947-0.953 on the public embryo but 0.90-0.92 on the train embryos, even with in-sample models (friend lab exp39 0.9143 on 199 videos; 12 LOEO-44b6 videos 0.900 for the 0.947 stack, RESULTS.md l.96-98). The private embryos are 'prepared the same way' as the public one, but no one knows their difficulty. Centre ~0.94 for x138, sd ~0.015. Our controllable part is +0.001..+0.003 over x138 (safetail/insertion/lowrefine/forkmid/F2 option), or +0.01..+0.03 in the world where an unpatched x138 guard degrades late private clips (s_critic sim; P of that world 0.03-0.2 by source). Expected private ~0.941-0.942. P(private >= 0.955) ~0.17, P(>= 0.96) ~0.10, P(>= 0.97) ~0.03, P(>= 0.99) ~0.001. Our moonshot bets contribute <= 0.005 of that 0.03; the rest is embryo luck. RELATIVE (what decides a medal): P(max(F1, F2) private > the x138 block) ~0.75-0.85. That holds if lowrefine is non-negative (P 0.6-0.8), insertion is non-negative (P ~0.7 if #35 >= #34 - 0.001), F2 is an independent chance, and the safety patch removes the one known way to fall below the block. WHY 0.97/0.99 ARE OUT OF REACH, AND THE CREDIBLE PATH TOWARD THEM (post-deadline, >= 2-3 weeks, >= 50-100 GPU-h): (a) a detector (primary + secondary) retrained embryo-held-out with dense labels on BOTH train embryos: dorado Ultrack for 44b6, Ultrack pseudo-labels for 6bba, optionally Zebrahub ZSNS001/003 (already mirrored on Kaggle by giorgosi) after resampling from DaXi optics, and Freitas CC0 synthetic pretraining on a small subset (hikaggler 0.9146 -> 0.9269 hold-out vs his own scratch model, 741749). It must be judged at matched N_pred on the held-out embryo. (b) The V1284-type head refit per-embryo-debiased on the new features. (c) An edge model trained on its own detections (exposure bias). (d) A division model with honest OOF plus conditional two-model fusion (the only ensemble form with public evidence). The top teams (Tang 6th: 'retrain... preprocessing, model architecture'; Civitasmass) describe exactly this. Nobody has published it, and every quick retrain we can see (leonixis 0.947, Kai-Gowers 0.927, ours 0.920/0.944) landed at or below the public weights.

slot_plan: 21 slots. Every submission needs the user's OK. Scoring latency 7-10 h. Last useful submission ~29 Sep 10:00 UTC. Expected use 6-9 slots; >= 6 stay reserved until 28 Sep 12:00 UTC. 25 SEP (1 slot): S01 is UNUSED by default. vitalii has ~0 GPU-h until 00:00 UTC, so no new kernel can be committed. Exception: #34 < 0.952 with a late latency (guard signature) AND the quota page shows >= 0.4 GPU-h -> exp58 = exp56 --set REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=34200 (10-min build) to test the guard hypothesis. 26 SEP (5): S02 ~00:50 UTC (if the user pre-approved and the unattended 00:05 push ran; otherwise ~07:45) = F1a = exp56 + safetail + lowrefine (+ divinsert with #35's config, gated, only if DR2 says include). It is scored ~08:00-17:00. S03 ~11:30 = M1 (F1a + DeepCenter t*) if E06 passes. S04 ~12:00 = F1b = F1a + forkmid if E04 passes. S05 ~13:30 = M2 (F1a + axis-flip) if E07 passes. S06 = reserve, used only to re-run F1a if S02 errored or timed out, or for the exp58 guard test. If a gate fails, its slot stays empty; it is NOT refilled with an ungated idea. 27 SEP (5): S07 ~01:00-08:00 = F1c, the default F1: F1a + every component that passed its lab gate AND scored >= its host - 0.001 (+ parrepair if E10 fired). S08 ~08:00-12:00 = M3 (dense secondary on F1a) if E08 passed every kill point; else C07 tempfuse if built; else empty. S09 = the other of {M3, C07}, or the M1+M2 combo if both scored >= F1a public; else empty. S10-S11 reserve (failure re-runs, E11 trigger). 28 SEP (5): S12 ~06:00 = the last NEW build, only if a component changed after S07 (e.g. F1c + M1 when M1 >= F1a + 0.001 public and its lab passed; or E12 on a pass). Code freeze 12:00 UTC. S13 ~10:00 = F2 confirmation (e.g. the best variance component on top of F1c) if needed. S14-S16 reserve. 29 SEP (5): S17-S18 before 10:00 UTC, only to re-run a finals candidate whose run errored or timed out. Nothing new. S19-S21 unused. BRANCHES. (A) #34 == 0.953 and #35 >= #34 - 0.001 with OK latency (P ~0.55): as above, with insertion in F1a. (B) #34 == 0.953 and #35 <= #34 - 0.002 (P ~0.3): F1a without insertion; C03 closed. (C) #34 < 0.952, an environment difference (P ~0.07): the base moves to the exp51/exp52 lineage. S02 = exp52 + safetail-equivalent fail-soft + forkmid (the exp39 base supports it). M1/M2 are ported via --set and the existing exp37 axis-flip patch. The same slot schedule applies. (D) Runtime trigger (#34 not visible by 15:39, #35 >= 8.5 h, error, or <= #34 - 0.008; P ~0.1-0.15): S02 = F1a with safetail (mandatory) and insertion OFF; E10 is built on 26 Sep; S06 or S07 = F1a + parrepair; F2 := exp52; M-variants still run but only as F1 riders.
decision_rules: DR1 base (#34). == 0.953 -> x138 is the base. 0.952 -> x138 with a log investigation. < 0.952 -> branch C (exp51/exp52 lineage), keep exp51 as the fallback. DR2 insertion (#35). Insertion goes into F1 only if #35 >= #34 - 0.001 AND #35 was visible by 16:03 UTC (or within 1 h of #34) AND it runs under safetail. #35 <= #34 - 0.002 -> no insertion. #35 <= #34 - 0.008, an error or a timeout -> guard/timeout signature, branch D. No ladder, no retune (C03). DR3 F2 policy, from latency. 'Runtime comfortable' (#34 visible < 15:39 and #35 < 16:03, and the E00 projection of F1 <= 9 h) -> F2 is the VARIANCE slot (see finals). Otherwise F2 := exp52 (guard-free, structurally different tail, public 0.950) and E10 is built. DR4 riders. A rider enters F1 only if its pre-registered lab gate passed AND the scored build containing it is >= its host - 0.001 public. A public delta < 0.002 is never attributed to a single rider. A lab-passed rider is never removed for a 0.001 public drop. Every rider keeps nodes identical, except C07 (+-1%). Node-count identity is the first gate. DR5 variance candidates (M1/M2/M3/C07). Each gets one slot only after its held-out gate passes (E06/E07/E08/E09). A candidate is killed on public < F1a - 0.002. At most one scored variant per mechanism. No threshold or knob ladders on public. DR6 slot discipline. >= 6 slots stay reserved until 28 Sep 12:00. An empty slot beats an ungated probe. One combo per day at most. DR7 freeze. The last new build is 28 Sep 06:00 UTC; code freeze 28 Sep 12:00. 29 Sep slots are only for re-running errored or timed-out finals candidates (submit <= 10:00 UTC). DR8 successor trigger. Port a public notebook only per E11's gate. PRIORITY ORDER when agent hours run short: E02 > E03 > E01 > E05 > E04 > E06 > E07 > E10 (if triggered) > E08 > E09 > E12. The safe F1 track must be in git before any moonshot code is started.
finals: Pre-registered (E01), ticked BY HAND by 29 Sep 20:00 UTC (reminder at 12:00 UTC). Kaggle auto-selection would pick the two best public near-copies.
